chunks.content: This runbook describes how to rotate a service credential without interrupting dependent applications. Notify service owners, create the replacement secret, update the staging integration, verify health checks, then rotate production consumers in small batches. Never include secret values in tickets or logs.
chunks.context_header: Confluence - confluence:KB-410 - Rotating service credentials safely - resolved
